groups.name: What the seed brings (read-only, walk first)

cases.title: The catalogue lists only the tools that are available
steps: Open the home page in a private window and sign in as member A.
cases.expected: Six tools. The two the seed puts on loan (ladder, sander) are not listed.

cases.title: A member asks for a tool
steps: As member A, open Tools and choose the drill.
cases.expected: The drill shows Requested, and My loans lists it as pending.
cases.note: Consumes the drill: it stays requested until the steward answers (B-03).

cases.title: The request reaches the steward's queue
steps: In another browser, sign in as the steward.
cases.expected: The queue holds 2 requests (1 seeded, 1 from B-02), the drill on top with member A's name.
